question: As a part of the Non-Cooperation Movement in 1922, the angry peasants had set ablaze the police station of which place?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chauri Chaura**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Chauri Chaura incident** occurred on **February 4, 1922**, during the **Non-Cooperation Movement** led by **Mahatma Gandhi**.
 
• This incident took place in the town of **Chauri Chaura**, located in the **Gorakhpur district of Uttar Pradesh**.
